paper.title: An Information-Theoretic Analysis of Thompson Sampling for Logistic Bandits

unmapped: Logistic link with known slope parameter beta>0: P(R=1|a,theta)=exp(beta<a,theta>)/(1+exp(beta<a,theta>))
Action set A and parameter set O both subsets of the d-dimensional unit ball; minimax alignment constant alpha = min_theta max_a <a,theta> assumed >= 0
settings.definition_quote: We consider a logistic bandit problem, where at each time step $t \in \{1,\ldots, T\}$, an agent selects an action $A_t \in \cA$ and receives a binary reward $R_t\in \{0,1\}$ with probability following a logistic function ... Here, $\beta>0$ is a known scale parameter ... both the action $a$ and the parameter vector $\theta$ lie within the $d$-dimensional Euclidean unit ball ... we assume the parameter vector $\Theta\in\cO$ is sampled from a known prior distribution $\bP_{\Theta}$.

symbols.Gamma_IR: upper bound on the average expected TS information ratio
symbols.H_eps: entropy of the parameter quantized on an epsilon-net
symbols.beta_s: slope parameter of the logistic function

source.label: thm:quantized_bound
source.quote: For all $\beta>0$, under the logistic bandit setting with logistic function $\phi_{\beta}(x)$, let the quantized parameter $\Theta_\varepsilon$ be defined as in~\Cref{def:quantized_parameter} for some $\varepsilon>0$. If the average expected TS information ratio is bounded, $\frac{1}{T} \sum_{t=1}^T \bE[\Gamma_t] \leq \Gamma$, for some $\Gamma>0$, then the TS regret is bounded as $\bE[\textnormal{Regret}(T)] \leq \sqrt{\Gamma T \left(\ent(\Theta_\varepsilon)+\varepsilon \beta T \right)}$.

results.notes: Conditional bound given an information-ratio bound. Regret defined with realized rewards under a prior; recorded as Bayesian regret.

conditions: A, O subsets of the d-dimensional unit ball

source.label: prop:info_ratio_logistic_bandits
source.quote: For all $\beta>0$, and for all $\cA, \cO \subseteq \mathbf{B}_d(0,1)$ with minimax alignment constant $\alpha$, under the logistic bandit setting with logistic function $\phi_{\beta}(x)$ the TS information ratio is bounded as $\Gamma_t \leq \frac{9}{2} d\alpha^{-2}$.

results.notes: Bound on the TS information ratio (not regret); quantity 'other'.

symbols.beta_s: slope parameter of the logistic function

conditions: A, O subsets of the d-dimensional unit ball

source.label: thm:main_theorem
source.quote: For all $\beta>0$, and for all $\cA, \cO \subseteq \mathbf{B}_d(0,1)$ with minimax alignment constant $\alpha$, under the logistic bandit setting with logistic function $\phi_{\beta}(x)$, the TS regret is bounded as $\bE[\textnormal{Regret}(T)] \leq 3d/\alpha\sqrt{ T \log\left(\sqrt{3+\frac{6 \beta T}{d}}\right)}$.

results.notes: Bayesian regret under known prior; TS does not use T so anytime.

symbols.beta_s: slope parameter of the logistic function

conditions: parameter set O is a subset of the unit sphere
O is a subset of the action set A
A subset of the unit ball

source.label: corollary_alpha_one
source.quote: For all $\beta>0$, under the logistic bandit setting with logistic function $\phi_{\beta}(x)$, let $\cA \subseteq \mathbf{B}_d(0,1)$ and $\cO \subseteq \mathbf{S}_d(0,1)$ be such that $\cO \subseteq \cA$. Then the TS regret is bounded as $\bE[\textnormal{Regret}(T)] \leq 3d\sqrt{T \log\left(\sqrt{3+\frac{6 \beta T}{d}}\right)}$.

results.notes: Special case alpha=1 of main theorem.

symbols.beta_s: slope parameter of the logistic function

conditions: action set A is chosen as a 1/2-net of the unit sphere with |A| <= 2d*3^(d-1)
parameter set O is any subset of the unit sphere

source.label: corollary:design
source.quote: For all $\beta>0$, under the logistic bandit setting with logistic function $\phi_{\beta}(x)$, there exists an action space $\cA$ with $|\cA| \leq 2d\cdot 3^{d-1}$ such that for any $\cO \subseteq \mathbf{S}_d(0,1)$, the TS regret is bounded as $\bE[\textnormal{Regret}(T)] \leq 6d\sqrt{ T \log\left(\sqrt{3+\frac{6 \beta T}{d}}\right)}$.

symbols.beta_s: slope parameter of the logistic function

conditions: compressed parameters satisfy the conditions of Dong & Van Roy (2018) Proposition 2

source.label: prop:adaptation
source.quote: For all $\beta>0$, under the logistic bandit setting with logistic function $\phi_{\beta}(x)$, letting $\tilde{\Theta}_t^\star$ and $\tilde{\Theta}_t$ satisfy the conditions in~\citet[Proposition 2]{dong_information-theoretic_2018}, the \emph{one-step compressed TS} information ratio is bounded as ... \leq d \frac{(1+\exp(\beta))^4}{32 \exp(\beta)^2}.

results.notes: Bound on the one-step compressed TS information ratio, an extension of Dong et al. 2019 Prop 17; algorithm is the compressed TS analysis device, not a regret bound.
